title: In Vivo Amelioration of Age-Associated Hallmarks by Partial Reprogramming
book_use: Chapter 13; The Reprogramming Bet; Checked 2026-09-08; Supports: cyclic partial OSKM induction; ~30% lifespan extension in progeroid mice; preserved tissue identity under the study protocol; Limits: Progeria mouse model of accelerated aging, not ordinary human aging; translational safety and efficacy remained unresolved.
